caption: A stack of coins on the corner of a kitchen counter is knocked off by an elbow and the coins scatter on the floor.

sa.check: A stack of coins stands on the corner of a kitchen counter.
An elbow knocks the stack off the counter.
The coins scatter on the floor.
Several coins are involved rather than a single one.
The knock comes first and the scattering follows.

pc.expect: The coins that leave the counter are the coins that arrive on the floor, keeping their number.
pc.fail: Coins appear on the floor that were never in the stack; or a coin vanishes on the way down; or the stack still stands whole on the counter after the coins have landed.

pc.expect: Every coin travels downward from the counter to the floor.
pc.fail: A coin rises after being knocked; or a coin hangs in the air beside the counter; or a coin climbs back onto the counter.

pc.expect: The stack breaks apart as it goes and the coins spread out on the floor below the corner, each spinning or bouncing to rest.
pc.fail: The coins fall as one rigid column and land still stacked; or they gather themselves back into a neat stack on the floor; or a coin rebounds higher than the counter it fell from.

pc.expect: The coins stay flat rigid discs, ringing and spinning on the floor.
pc.fail: A coin bends or folds where it lands; or a coin splashes on the tiles; or a coin sinks into the floor as if into mud.

pc.expect: The coins, the counter and the floor stay solid and separate.
pc.fail: A coin passes through the counter or through the floor; or two coins merge into one; or a coin turns into another object mid-fall.

pc.expect: Everything in view, named in the caption or not, keeps its number, identity and shape unless something visible acts on it, and nothing passes through anything else.
pc.fail: An object that nothing visible acts on appears from nothing; or vanishes while still in frame and not occluded; or duplicates or merges with another; or turns into a different object or a different shape between frames; or any object passes through another. Changes brought about by the caption's event or by a visible interaction, objects leaving the frame, and occlusion are not failures.

pc.expect: The coins' colour, the counter and the kitchen stay the same.
pc.fail: A coin changes colour or size as it falls; or the counter's surface changes pattern between frames; or the kitchen behind rearranges.

note: The elbow is kept as the minimal trigger for the fall; the person behind it is not judged.
